text: Soluna Harness 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工程任务编排插件。它通过 profile 级 Cordis bundle 注入系统提示，并注册十个工具，让 DSH 会话将复杂开发请求交给 Sol 规划、Luna 实现和修复，再进行验证与 Sol 审查。用户可以采用完整自动运行，也可以分步提交计划、结果和审查，并查询、恢复或取消已保存的运行。它还支持按依赖和文件归属安排任务包。适合希望在 DSH 中管理多阶段代码修改与验证的开发者；需要 Harness 模型提供方和子 agent 提供方配置。

Soluna Harness orchestrates engineering tasks in DeepSeek Harness. Ten tools coordinate planning, implementation, verification, and review across Sol, Luna, and Terra. Run the full workflow or advance it step by step; inspect, resume, or cancel saved runs. Requires model and subagent providers.
想让 DSH 把复杂开发需求拆成计划、实现、验证和最终审查几个阶段。
能不能让多个 agent 按文件分工做代码任务，并避免同时改同一文件？
我想先让模型给出工程计划，确认后再派发实现工作。
让 DSH 记录一次代码修改流程，之后能查看状态、继续运行或取消。
I want an agent workflow that plans a coding task, implements it, verifies the changes, and reviews the result.
Can I resume or cancel a saved engineering run from my DSH session?
Soluna Harness 的功能「完整工程运行」：在 DSH 调用 soluna_run 并提供任务与工作目录，可启动持久化流程；默认执行规划、实现或修复、验证和审查，并返回运行状态。
Soluna Harness 的功能「协作式计划与分步提交」：用户可先调用 soluna_plan 持久化任务分类和侦察结果，再通过提交计划、实现结果及审查决定的工具推进运行。
Soluna Harness 的功能「运行状态管理」：通过 soluna_status 查看单次运行或运行列表，使用 soluna_resume 继续未结束的运行，或用 soluna_cancel 取消运行。

@soluna-harness/install README · Why Soluna?：Coding agents are good at changing files. Shipping reliable software needs more: scoped plans, explicit ownership, deterministic verification, independent review, bounded retries, cancellation, and evidence you can inspect later.

Soluna turns that engineering discipline into a reusable orchestration layer:

@soluna-harness/install README · Why Soluna?：| Role | Responsibility | Default route |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Sol** | Architecture planning and independent final review | `gpt-5.6-sol`, high / xhigh |
| **Luna** | Repository exploration, implementation, testing, and repair | `gpt-5.6-luna`, max |
| **Terra** | Escalation after Luna exhausts its retry budget | `gpt-5.6-terra`, high |

@soluna-harness/install README · What you get：- **Automatic L0–L5 routing** — trivial edits stay lightweight; risky work earns a real plan and review.
- **Validated implementation packets** — file ownership, invariants, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and structured verification commands.
- **DAG-aware scheduling** — independent packets can run concurrently; overlapping ownership is rejected.
- **Verification as a gate** — allowlisted argv execution, bounded output, timeouts, cancellation, and no shell interpolation.
- **Workspace accountability** — Git HEAD and content hashes detect unreported or out-of-scope edits.
- **Durable runs** — atomic state snapshots plus append-only worker, workspace, verification, and review evidence.
- **Fail-closed safety** — strict schemas, bounded context, secret redaction, symlink/traversal rejection, and ownership-safe uninstall.
- **Zero project configuration by default** — add `.soluna.toml` only when you want policy overrides.

@soluna-harness/install README · Requirements：- Node.js `>=20`
- For Codex CLI/MCP use: an authenticated [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) installation (`0.150.1` is the validated baseline)
- For native DSH use: DeepSeek Harness `0.1.x` (`0.1.0-rc.7` validated), an in-process `spawn` subagent provider, and an authenticated model provider such as Codex Connect's `openai-codex` route
- Access to configured planning, implementation, and escalation model IDs; availability is deployment-specific

@soluna-harness/install README · Install from source：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Leopold-Fitz-AI/soluna-harness.git
cd soluna-harness
npm ci
npm test

Install into Codex:

```bash
node dist/cli-entry.js install --platform codex
node dist/cli-entry.js doctor --platform codex
```

Install into the DeepSeek Harness `web` profile:

```bash
node dist/cli-entry.js install \
  --platform dsh \
  --dsh-profile web \
  --package-spec "$PWD"

Or install both at once:

@soluna-harness/install README · Install from source：```bash
node dist/cli-entry.js install \
  --platform all \
  --dsh-profile web \
  --package-spec "$PWD"

`npm link` exposes the local `soluna` executable; remove it later with `npm unlink -g @soluna-harness/install`. The Codex installer creates a timestamped config backup and records every owned setting/file. The DSH installer delegates package reconciliation to `dsh plugin` and preserves independently managed or user-modified dependencies during uninstall.

@soluna-harness/install README · Use it in Codex：Start a **new Codex session** inside a trusted Git repository:

```bash
cd your-project
codex
```

Then ask normally:

```text
Implement role-based access control for the API, add regression tests,
and verify backward compatibility.
```

The implicit `soluna-orchestration` skill routes non-trivial work automatically. You can also be explicit:

@soluna-harness/install README · Use it in Codex：```text
Use Soluna orchestration. Have Sol produce the plan, let Luna implement and
repair it, run every required verification gate, then have Sol review the result.
```

Useful operational commands:

```bash
soluna doctor                    # validate installation and model routes
soluna status                    # list persisted runs
soluna status <RUN_ID>           # inspect one run
soluna resume <RUN_ID>           # continue a cooperative run

@soluna-harness/install README · Use it in DeepSeek Harness：After installing the bundle, restart the selected DSH profile. Sessions in that profile receive a scoped orchestration prompt plus ten native tools:

```text
soluna_run          soluna_plan          soluna_submit_plan
soluna_dispatch     soluna_verify        soluna_review
soluna_resume       soluna_status        soluna_cancel
soluna_doctor

@soluna-harness/install README · Use it in DeepSeek Harness：> In DSH, Sol/Luna/Terra run as native in-process Harness subagents. Their model requests use Codex Connect's `openai-codex` provider by default, so DSH's OAuth connection, agent loop, tools, sandbox, approvals, and cancellation remain authoritative. The external Codex CLI is retained for standalone CLI/MCP use but is not required by this native DSH path. Override the routes with `SOLUNA_DSH_MODEL_PROVIDER` and `SOLUNA_DSH_SUBAGENT_PROVIDER` when needed.

@soluna-harness/install README · DeepSeek Harness Cordis bundle：Both surfaces share the same schemas, scheduler, persistence, token ledger, verification engine, and safety model.

@soluna-harness/install README · Configuration：Projects need no Soluna files. To override policy, add `.soluna.toml`:

```toml
version = 1

[quality]
requireTests = true

The model IDs above match the validated deployment but are not assumed to exist for every Codex account. Override `roleModels` with routes available in your model catalog, then run `soluna doctor` before starting work.

Precedence is:

```text
built-in defaults → machine config → user config → project .soluna.toml → task overrides
```

@soluna-harness/install README · CLI reference：```text
soluna install [--platform codex|dsh|all] [--dsh-profile web] [--package-spec SPEC]
soluna uninstall [--platform codex|dsh|all] [--dsh-profile web]
soluna doctor [--platform codex|dsh|all] [--json] [--live]
soluna status [RUN_ID]

`doctor --live` performs paid, opt-in model smoke tests. Ordinary doctor checks are non-generative.
@soluna-harness/install README · Security model：Soluna is designed to make orchestration evidence explicit, not to turn untrusted repositories into trusted code.

@soluna-harness/install README · Security model：- Model output crosses strict Zod / JSON Schema boundaries.
- Context compilation rejects traversal, symlinks, secret-like paths, binaries, and hard-limit overflow.
- Child processes use argv arrays; verification has an executable allowlist and repository-contained cwd.
- Secrets are redacted before model/backend output is persisted or returned through status tools.
- Dirty worktrees, non-Git roots, nested Git cwd, and workspace symlinks fail closed by default.
- Installer ownership records prevent uninstall from deleting user-modified configuration or DSH packages.

@soluna-harness/install README · Security model：Repository test/build scripts remain trusted code and execute with the host process's OS permissions. Read the complete [security policy](SECURITY.md) before using Soluna on sensitive code.
